results.title: Sleep Apnea Researcher Receives Lifetime Achievement Award
results.content: **Summary:** Atul Malhotra, MD, a leading figure in pulmonary, critical care, and sleep medicine at UC San Diego, has been awarded the 2024 Sleep and Respiratory Neurobiology Lifetime Achievement Award by the American Thoracic Society. At UC San Diego Health, Malhotra provides a full spectrum of diagnostic and therapeutic services to patients with sleep-related disorders, including sleep apnea, insomnia, restless leg syndrome, narcolepsy, and sleep disorders associated with medical or psychiatric conditions. “I am incredibly honored for this recognition by the American Thoracic Society and my esteemed peers,” says Malhotra, research chief of Pulmonary, Critical Care and Sleep Medicine at UC San Diego School of Medicine, in a release. “Dr Malhotra’s research has deepened our knowledge of fundamental disease mechanisms, which has translated into new therapies that are improving patient outcomes,” says Zea Borok, MD, chair of the Department of Medicine at UC San Diego School of Medicine, in a release. Before joining UC San Diego Health in 2013, Malhotra practiced pulmonary, critical care, and sleep medicine at Massachusetts General Hospital, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, and Brigham and Women’s Hospital.
